columns.comment: Calendar month of the presentation receipt as its first day (DATE): September 2026 = DATE'2026-09-01' (the month-end snapshot as of 30-Sep-2026). This view is monthly; point-in-time measures grouped by a longer period (quarter, half, fiscal year) return its last month. The latest month is Sep 2026.
columns.name: Month

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label of the presentation receipt, April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027, FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026. "This year" / YTD = FY2026 to 30-Sep-2026; year-on-year compares the same months of FY2025.
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2: Q1 = Apr-Jun, Q2 = Jul-Sep, Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar (FY2026-Q4 = Jan-Mar 2027). The latest quarter is FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: Fiscal Quarter

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1: H1 = Apr-Sep, H2 = Oct-Mar. H1 FY2026 (Apr-Sep 2026) closed on 30-Sep-2026; compare with FY2025-H1 for year-on-year.
columns.name: Fiscal Half

columns.comment: Always true here: this view is monthly, every row is a month-end snapshot or a whole-month total (kept so the same filter works in daily and monthly views).
columns.name: Is Month End

columns.comment: True for September 2026, the latest (as-of) month - use it for "today", "current", "latest" or "right now" questions on balances and other point-in-time measures.
columns.name: Is Latest Month

columns.comment: Client group = the global parent group, as its short brand (e.g. Kinokawa Precision, Hayashi Marine Logistics, Sunda Energi Nusantara). "Client" or "group" without qualification means this level. Match names with LIKE '%Kinokawa%'. About 380 groups.
columns.name: Client Group

columns.comment: Legal entity (golden client) with its location, e.g. Kinokawa Precision (Singapore) Pte Ltd - "entity" or "subsidiary" means this level. About 2,500 entities; match with LIKE '%Kinokawa%Singapore%'.
columns.name: Client

columns.comment: Client segment: Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: Segment

columns.comment: Relationship tier - Strategic, Core or Transactional. "Strategic clients" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
columns.name: Relationship Tier

columns.comment: True for APAC subsidiaries of Japanese groups (segment Japanese Corporate) - "Japanese corporates", "JC" or "Japanese clients" means true.
columns.name: Is Japanese Corporate

columns.comment: Industry sector of the APAC taxonomy (e.g. Technology, Materials, Energy, Industrials); see Subsector.
columns.name: Industry

columns.comment: Industry subsector within the sector (e.g. Semiconductors, Automotive Parts, Coal Mining, Shipping).
columns.name: Subsector

columns.comment: APAC booking location covering the client, ISO-2 code: SG Singapore, HK Hong Kong, CN China, TH Thailand, ID Indonesia, IN India, AU Australia, VN Vietnam, MY Malaysia, KR South Korea, TW Taiwan, PH Philippines, NZ New Zealand. "Country" means this unless the user says risk / HQ country.
columns.name: Coverage Office

columns.comment: Primary relationship manager (fictional name) at the row's month-end: the CRM primary-RM assignment, else the group account-plan owner; null = no RM coverage.
columns.name: Primary RM

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location, ISO-2) where the primary RM sits - "RMs in Singapore / Hong Kong" means this (most RMs also cover clients booked in other countries, so it differs from Coverage Office).
columns.name: Primary RM Office

columns.comment: Internal rating grade 1-10 in force at the row's month-end (1 best, 10 default; 7 and worse is sub-investment watch territory); null = not rated (no credit relationship).
columns.name: Rating Grade

columns.comment: IFRS 9 stage at the row's month-end: 1 performing, 2 significant increase in credit risk, 3 credit-impaired / default; null = not rated.
columns.name: IFRS 9 Stage

columns.comment: True when the client is on the credit watchlist at the row's month-end ("not on the watchlist" = false).
columns.name: Watchlist

columns.comment: KYC / AML risk rating Low, Medium or High at the row's month-end (latest completed review); null = no KYC record.
columns.name: KYC Risk Rating

columns.comment: Final early-warning band at the row's month-end: Green (score < 40), Amber (40-69) or Red (>= 70), after overrides; null = not scored (no credit relationship, or before Apr-2025).
columns.name: EWS Band

columns.comment: Booking location of the LC (ISO-2) - "country" in trade-operations questions means this.
columns.name: Booking Country

columns.comment: Import LC or Export LC.
columns.name: Product

columns.comment: Main discrepancy found: Inconsistent Data Between Documents, Late Shipment, Late Presentation, Insurance Document Deficiency, Description of Goods Mismatch, Bill of Lading Not Clean, Invoice Amount Exceeds LC, Missing Document, Certificate of Origin Issue; None for complying presentations; null while pending.
columns.name: Discrepancy Type

columns.comment: Trade operations team that examined the documents (e.g. SG Trade Ops Hub, VN Trade Ops).
columns.name: Operations Team

columns.comment: Complying, Discrepant - Waived, Discrepant - Refused or Pending Examination.
columns.name: Decision

columns.comment: True when the documents were found discrepant.
columns.name: Is Discrepant

columns.comment: True when the examination took longer than the 24-hour SLA.
columns.name: Is Over SLA

columns.comment: True when the documents were re-presented after a refusal.
columns.name: Is Re-presentation

columns.comment: True for clients whose discrepancy rate rose by 10 points or more from H2 FY2025 (Oct-2025 to Mar-2026) to H1 FY2026 (Apr-Sep 2026), with >= 3 examined presentations in each half - an early-warning input (as of 30-Sep-2026).
columns.name: Is Client Discrepancy Rising

columns.comment: Document presentations received in the selected months (a flow).
columns.name: Presentations

columns.comment: Presentations whose examination is complete (the denominator of the rates).
columns.name: Examined Presentations

columns.comment: Presentations found discrepant.
columns.name: Discrepant Presentations

columns.comment: Discrepant / examined presentations (fraction; 0.22 = 22%).
columns.name: Discrepancy Rate %

columns.comment: Share of discrepant presentations whose discrepancies the applicant waived (fraction); the rest were refused.
columns.name: Waiver Rate %

columns.comment: Median hours from receipt to completed examination over examined presentations (SLA 24 hours).
columns.name: Median Turnaround Hours

columns.comment: 90th-percentile examination turnaround in hours (exact percentile).
columns.name: P90 Turnaround Hours

columns.comment: Examination SLA in hours (24).
columns.name: SLA Hours

columns.comment: Examined presentations that took longer than the 24-hour SLA.
columns.name: Presentations Over SLA

columns.comment: Share of examined presentations over the 24-hour SLA (fraction).
columns.name: Over SLA %

columns.comment: Distinct LCs with a presentation in the selection.
columns.name: LCs Presented

columns.comment: LC amendments per LC = amendments of the LCs (counted once, on their first presentation) / LCs presented in the selection.
columns.name: Amendments per Transaction

columns.comment: Clients whose discrepancy rate rose >= 10 points from H2 FY2025 to H1 FY2026 (early-warning input).
columns.name: Clients with Rising Discrepancy Rate

comment: Trade operations on LC document presentations (import and export LCs), May-2023 to Sep-2026: presentations, discrepancy rate and types, waivers / refusals, examination turnaround (median / P90 hours vs the 24-hour SLA), presentations over SLA, and LC amendments per transaction, by booking country, product, discrepancy type and operations team - plus the clients whose discrepancy rate is rising (H2 FY2025 -> H1 FY2026, an early-warning input). Counts add up over months; rates are ratios over examined presentations; medians are exact. Grain: one row per LC document presentation (gold.fact_trade_document_check).
